note: The main banks, chosen as the best-known large card issuers (no central bank ranking was read): KBZ Bank, AYA Bank and CB Bank; none was tried this time, for want of the research's budget, and UAB Bank's schedule, already found, was read again. UAB Bank's fees and charges (updated 2 August 2026), its credit card section, read in full on 2026-10-30 (first read 2026-10-29 for the Gold alone): the Platinum and Gold credit cards cost 60,000 and 30,000 kyat to issue and 120,000 and 60,000 a year; interest is 18% a year where the repayment isn't made in full by the due date; a cash advance bears 3.25% a month and a withdrawal at UAB's ATMs costs 5% (at least 5,000 kyat; 15% at other banks' ATMs, not written); the cross-border transaction fee is 21.65% a transaction, written as the foreign transaction share. The late fee is stated only as a minimum of 10,000 and a maximum of 20,000 kyat, with no rate between them, and isn't written. The Gold's issue fee, left out on 2026-10-29, is now written.
